name: Boiler rifle
description: The boiler rifle was a model of short-range blaster rifle that could be modified with an underbarrel spin-sealed bottle of tibanna gas that illegally doubled the weapon's fire power. In 1 BBY, the Rebel Alliance Special Forces commando Paodok'Draba'Takat Sap'De'Rekti Nik'Linke'Ti' Ki'Vef'Nik'NeSevef'Li'Kek used a black market boiler rifle during the Battle of Scarif.
